comment: * WebViewRenderProcess provides an opaque handle to a WebView renderer.

methods.name: public abstract boolean terminate()
methods.comment:
* Cause this renderer to terminate. * *

Calling this on a not yet started, or an already terminated renderer will have no effect. * *

Terminating a renderer process may have an effect on multiple * {@link android.webkit.WebView} instances. * *

RenderProcess termination must be handled by properly overriding * {@link android.webkit.WebViewClient#onRenderProcessGone} for every WebView that shares this * renderer. If termination is not handled by all associated WebViews, then the application * process will also be terminated. * *

This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#WEB_VIEW_RENDERER_TERMINATE}. * * @return {@code true} if it was possible to terminate this renderer, {@code false} otherwise.
